episodes.title: Dark Lover - Episode 1
episodes.summary: Darius makes an impossible request of his fellow Brother, Wrath. The Black Dagger Brotherhood suffers a direct attack from the Lessening society. Darius's half breed daughter, Beth meets Wrath and their connection is immediate.

episodes.title: Dark Lover - Episode 2
episodes.summary: The Brotherhood hunts for the Lessening Society's base. Butch reveals his feelings to Beth. Wrath discloses the truth about Beth's father's identity and nature.

episodes.title: Dark Lover - Episode 3
episodes.summary: Wrath and Marissa's history emerges. Mr. X targets Billy Riddle. Butch's concern for Beth intensifies. Beth encounters Tohrment. A private dinner strengthens Wrath and Beth's connection.

episodes.title: Dark Lover - Episode 4
episodes.summary: Rhage unleashes his beast. Wrath opens up to Beth. Mr. X punishes a lesser and invites Billy to join the Society. Beth's transition begins and Butch rushes her to Wrath where he meets the Brotherhood.

episodes.title: Dark Lover - Episode 5
episodes.summary: Beth survives the transition with Wrath's help. As their bond deepens, the house prepares for a major ceremony. Wrath seeks guidance from the Scribe Virgin. Butch learns the truth about the vampire world. Mr. X and the Omega target Billy Riddle. Havers begins plotting his revenge.

episodes.title: Dark Lover - Episode 6
episodes.summary: Wrath learns of a murder plot against him. Mr. X kidnaps Beth. Wrath rallies the Brotherhood and Butch for a rescue mission. As night falls, the battle begins.
